scope: Offline bounded complete-scan/review prototype; no FR-18–21 acceptance, full-photo quality, human-time or platform-resource claim.

model.tree_hash_algorithm: SHA256(json.dumps(sorted file records by path, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)).encode(UTF-8)); records contain path,bytes,sha256; excludes directories.

input.name: image
input.padding_semantics: Black pixel values normalized like all RGB pixels; no additional internal model padding mask.

logits.tail: 252 masked negative logits; negative infinity or finite negative sentinel allowed; NaN/+infinity forbidden.

model.score: maximum sigmoid over the four valid text-token logits; score strictly greater than0.23; no user slider; proposal maximum inside converted graph is also over these four tokens.

scan.root_starts: For each positive upright dimension L: [0] when L<=400; otherwise unique ascending 0,200,...<=L-400 plus L-400. Always400 logical context; black fill outside source when L<400.
scan.root_ownership: Axis context centers=start+200. Boundaries=[0]+midpoints of adjacent centers+[L]. Cartesian cells partition source exactly, half-open [left,right)x[top,bottom). Row-major y then x. Do not round boundaries.
scan.scheduling: Root row-major; saturated owners enqueue four child quadrants row-major, breadth-first by root order. Batch1, serial prediction; one queued descriptor, no decoded crop queue.
scan.saturation: Exactly900 raw queries with score>0.23 BEFORE coordinate/content/ownership filtering; drop ALL rows from saturated parent owner, including provisionally valid centers.

recovery.child_ownership: Four equal half-open quadrants exactly partition parent owner; fractional bounds preserved, no clipping/rounding.
recovery.child_context: Logical rectangle exactly2x child-owner width and2x child-owner height centered on child. Uniform fit to800square using side=max(logical width,height); black outside exact logical rectangle and outside source.
recovery.side_interpretation: Maximum logical dimension. Interior parent200px owners yield100px child owners/200px contexts. Outer parent owners can be300px wide and produce300px contexts; not all children are200px.
recovery.terminal: Saturated child, side outside bounds, unrepresentable/invalid geometry or inability to admit all four children fails entire run; no second subdivision.

scan.rasterization: Square integer logical contexts: bilinear source crop enlarged uniformly to800, with black source-border fill. Rectangular/fractional: center logical rect on virtual square, mask source pixel centers outside exact logical rect, bilinear pixel-center sampling and output logical-content mask. Native implementation must verify against retained research input pixels/geometry; geometry contract is not measured native parity.
scan.inverse_geometry: Let virtual square origin=(sl,st), side=S. Model normalized box maps center=(sl+cx*S,st+cy*S), extent=(w*S,h*S) in Double upright source pixels. No half-pixel point shift, box clipping or center clamp. Retain only valid centers inside source AND node ownership; no pixels outside logical context count as content.
scan.reconciliation: Ownership only. No NMS, within-pass suppression, radius cluster, coordinate averaging, overview pass or cross-scale union. Remaining duplicates are reviewable; large-bird fragmentation is unvalidated.
scan.near_committed_marker: Advisory only: radius=max(2,min(12,0.25*min(sourceBoxWidth,sourceBoxHeight))) source pixels; nearest marker within inclusive radius wins, lower current label breaks exact tie. Start excluded but retain for deliberate inclusion.
scan.apply: Generate fresh ordinary marker UUIDs once; one atomic ApplyBatch history/recovery transaction; no detector provenance persisted.

limits.root_preflight: Reject >20 roots before model load. Before each recovery admit all four children only if executed+remaining planned predictions+4<=20; otherwise fail all.

failures: resource preflight or runtime memory pressure
malformed shape or dtype or unsafe tensor count
NaN or positive-infinite logits or uninterpretable scores
above-threshold invalid/nonfinite box, nonpositive extent or invalid model center
source identity or run key mismatch
failure_contract.effect: No eligible preview, complete suggestion total or history/count mutation. Diagnostics may retain incomplete data clearly marked ineligible. A complete zero requires every ownership cell resolved and every run/key/resource/deadline check valid.
failure_contract.cancellation: Immediately revoke publication eligibility; synchronous Core ML may continue until return. Keep sole serial owner/source lease until drained; block retry model ownership until cleanup. Manual committed count remains usable.

open_acceptance: clean FP32 app CPU high-water and cold/warm resource measurements
Intel runtime and universal Mac build
actual manual vs detection+review completion time and correction actions
final exact redistribution notices and training-provenance treatment
designer_evidence: Use actual retained suggestions only, labeled with source SHA256, source/native configuration, ROI/full-scan scope and completeness. Recorded research outputs cannot imply an eligible live scan or enable complete Apply; no fabricated verified totals or human-time results.
